headline: Kai, talk of reopening Hormuz in phases has oil back under $93 and the 10-year finally catching its breath.
subline: Futures lean green after Thursday's whipsaw, October-hike odds sit near 70 percent, and durable goods plus a weak Michigan sentiment read land this morning.
asof: Pre-market · as of 6:55 AM ET · index figures are futures · every figure links to its source below

items.title: Thursday's whipsaw ends roughly where it started
items.sentence: The AP tally at ABC News has the S&P 500 off 1.90 points at 7,704.13 after a couple of intraday reversals, with the Dow down 161.61 to 51,349.98 and the Nasdaq up 3.34 to 26,939.37.

items.title: Futures lean green into a durable-goods morning
items.sentence: Investing.com's board has S&P 500 futures up 0.17 percent, Nasdaq 100 futures up 0.37 percent and Dow futures 0.20 percent higher ahead of this morning's durable-goods orders and final September consumer-sentiment reading.

items.title: Ten-year eases to 5.18% after a three-day surge
items.sentence: Trading Economics shows the benchmark down about 3 basis points from 5.21 percent after a 23-basis-point, three-session climb, with markets still pricing roughly 70 percent odds of another Fed hike at the next meeting.

items.title: WTI snaps its rally below $93 on phased-deal reports
items.sentence: Trading Economics ties the 1.95 percent slide to $92.77 to reports of a Qatar-mediated US-Iran deal that would reopen the Strait of Hormuz in phases and lift blockades on Iranian ports, even as Houthi attacks on Saudi cities keep supply on edge.

items.title: Gold steadies at $4,300 as the yield surge pauses
items.sentence: Trading Economics has bullion up $25.35 on the day after a week of pressure from a stronger dollar and rate-hike expectations, leaving the metal still down 6.39 percent on the month.

items.title: Costco beats on $95.7 billion in revenue
items.sentence: Yahoo Finance reports fiscal Q4 earnings of $6.75 a share against a $6.55 estimate on 19.5 percent e-commerce growth, a beat the market met with a 0.3 percent shrug after hours.

items.title: Bitcoin slips to $83,500 as hike bets mount
items.sentence: CoinDesk pegs the 24-hour drop at about $2,100, or 2.47 percent, as traders price in four Fed rate hikes by June 2027, with the broader CD20 index down 4.19 percent.

items.title: US and Iran said to weigh phased Hormuz reopening
items.sentence: CNBC reported oil pulled back from session highs on word of talks over a phased reopening of the strait, the first sign of an off-ramp since the war closed it to shipping.

items.title: Trump and Xi de-escalate; Iran and Taiwan unresolved
items.sentence: Al Jazeera's summit read has Xi invoking the Thucydides Trap and pressing Trump to oppose Taiwanese independence, while Trump called it a 'great meeting' but offered few concrete outcomes and no breakthrough on isolating Iran.

items.title: Pope Leo XIV lands in France to ringing bells
items.sentence: Euronews shows President Macron greeting the pope at Orly Airport this morning as church bells sounded nationwide for the visit.

items.title: Fourteen Kazakh soldiers found dead in the Caspian
items.sentence: The soldiers were discovered after a naval training exercise, per Euronews, which reports authorities are investigating what went wrong.

items.title: Russian strikes knock out Kyiv data centers
items.sentence: TechStartups reports Tuesday's strikes damaged core network equipment and a central traffic-exchange facility, disconnecting roughly 100,000 households while repair crews work to restore service.

items.title: DeepSeek hits $1 billion run rate, seeks $7.5 billion
items.sentence: TechStartups reports the Chinese lab's annualized revenue doubled after price increases of 2.3 to 4.5 times held up under demand, as it prepares a raise valuing it near $74 billion.

items.title: Gemini 4 enters post-training, ships by year-end
items.sentence: DeepMind chief Koray Kavukcuoglu says he is 'a hundred percent confident' Google remains at the frontier, with the model already used internally on its Antigravity coding tool, per TechStartups.

items.title: Amazon opens seller accounts to AI agents, Claude first
items.sentence: A new beta lets autonomous agents manage listings, inventory and advertising for US sellers, beginning with Anthropic's Claude, per TechStartups.

items.title: Filings: ChatGPT underperformed inside Apple Intelligence
items.sentence: Court documents show the integration 'dramatically underperformed' expectations and the anticipated halo effect never materialized, per TechStartups.

items.title: Oracle invokes force majeure on 2.45-gigawatt data center
items.sentence: The move shields Oracle from payment obligations if the New Mexico Project Jupiter site misses its 2028 launch deadline, per TechStartups, a reminder that AI capex timelines are starting to meet reality.
